title.narrative: Brazil Electromobility Multiphase Programmatic Approach – MPA Phase 1 CEF

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to improve quality and reduce emissions of public transport in Brazilian cities.

The proposed US$ 500 million IPF - Brazil Electromobility Multiphase Programmatic Approach – MPA Phase 1 Caixa (P504543) aims to accelerate the decarbonization of urban transport in Brazilian cities by financing electric buses (e-buses) and associated infrastructure. It is part of Phase 1 of the Brazil Electromobility Multiphase Programmatic Approach (MPA), to be implemented by Caixa Economica Federal (CEF), acting as the financial intermediary. Phase 1 addresses key market barriers, particularly the lack of affordable long-term financing for electromobility projects, one of the key factors that has hindered large-scale e-bus adoption. The Project will establish a credit line to finance the purchase or construction of e-buses and related infrastructure, including charging stations and energy grid upgrades, while providing technical assistance and capacity-building for CEF and end-borrowers. A Project Development Facility will offer comprehensive support and assistance—technical, economic, financial, operational and legal—throughout the development and implementation of the electromobility projects. This facility will foster innovative business models, reduce market and technological risks, and thereby unlock private capital mobilization (PCM) in the next MPA phases to enable the large-scale deployment of e-buses in Brazil. Strengthening CEF's institutional and fiduciary capacity is essential to create a financial instrument that effectively utilizes public funds for e-bus procurement, which is particularly important as the sector stabilizes in terms of commercial risk perception. Improved capacity is also crucial to support CEF's access sustainable finance markets in line with international best practices, including meeting environmental and social standards, gender inclusion, public procurement and participation in carbon market.The project will consist of two main components:i. Component 1: Investment in electromobility and energy transition projects. This component will finance (a) the decarbonization of public transport; and (b) the preparation of infrastructure in participating cities to promote energy transition.ii. Component 2: Project facility and institutional strengthening. This component will finance (a) project facility to support the end borrower on project structuring and feasibility studies; (b) to strengthen CEF's institutional capacity for assisting Project implementation; (iii) the study and training of CEF's team to operate in the carbon market, as well as providing support for the implementation of an MRV (Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification) platform.
